name: movscript
description: MovScript project focus, domain source editing, planning, review, media query, AI generation, and Electron media editing tools backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, domain source, planning, review, media queries, generation, and Electron media editing.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/domain/planning/review/generation/editing guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. The MCP bridge exposes system tools for focus, project creation, resources, external media, model discovery, image/video/audio/subtitle generation, and job polling, plus domain tools for object query/read/upsert/update, candidate management, inspect/review, interpret, and regeneration planning. Product video editing uses the dedicated editing_* tool family: MediaEditingProject creation, timeline mutation, Electron mediaPipeline render/HLS/transcode/reframe tasks, export import, HLS publishing, and explicit candidate creation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's system_* tools for current focus, resource-library lookup, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, and image/video/audio/subtitle generation. Use domain_* tools for MovScript project domain objects: query/read/upsert/update source entities, manage candidates, inspect/review changes, interpret, and read regeneration state. For product video editing, use editing_* tools: create a MediaEditingProject from domain edit_plan context, mutate tracks/clips with editing_timeline_*, check editing_runtime_capabilities_get before local render, and run render/HLS/transcode/reframe through Electron mediaPipeline. Import exports or publish HLS only with explicit editing_export_* tools, and create/adopt/select candidates only when the user or workflow asks for that state change. Resource-level media utilities are only for neutral material preparation, not the main editing path. Treat generation input_resource_ids/reference_resource_ids as MovScript RawResource IDs only. For domain changes, prefer structured domain APIs; when an API does not cover the requested field or structure, call domain_get_model and edit source files under project.json, project_standards.json, settings/**, scripts/**, content_units/**, or productions/**. After each coherent semantic source change, run domain_inspect or domain_review, fix blocking issues, then run domain_interpret. Use domain_regeneration_plan after interpret for affected/stale downstream content units; affected means review, not automatic regeneration.
